verdict.rationale: Greptile's core function is generating AI insights and suggestions from the user's own codebase. It produces PR review comments with suggested code, a 0-5 merge-safety score with a verdict, severity-sorted findings, diagrams, generated tests and a synthesized repo knowledge base, and a user reports it 'catches real issues.' Some early hands-on reports of incomplete answers and processing errors lower confidence but do not concretely refute the review capability. Missing for 10: insights are mostly surfaced on the Git host's PRs, CLI or agents rather than a documented in-product dashboard view, and independent corroboration of suggestion quality is mixed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.
Every review comment includes a Fix with your Agent button that sends the issue — with file paths, line numbers, and suggested code
Confidence score and a short verdict at the top. A Findings list sorted by severity, with links to each comment.
Parse complex changes with sequence diagrams and flowcharts generated for every PR
Read the knowledge base - Get Greptile's synthesized documentation for an enrolled repository
more often than not it catches real issues and gives the author a chance to reply or fix them before another human reviews the PR.
